items.title: Tensoring a dg module with a complex of modules gives a functor to complexes of sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-tensor-with-complex at source lines 6118-6129: in the situation considered above there is a functor of differential graded categories from dg E-modules to the dg category of complexes of O-modules, tensoring with the complex K, which sends E to K and commutes with direct sums. The proof at source lines 6131-6153 is a reduction to the pointwise statement plus the two structure checks. It observes that for every object U of the site the complex K(U) is simultaneously a left dg E-module and a right O(U)-module with commuting actions, that is, a dg bimodule, so that the author's tensor functor with this bimodule gives a functor of dg categories at each U; it then has to see that these pointwise functors assemble into a functor landing in the dg category of complexes of O-modules, which uses the functoriality of the construction in U, and finally that the assembled functor sends E to K and preserves direct sums, which is read off from the pointwise statement. The statement records none of these three observations. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
